problems.reason: Sentences 17, 18 and 19 present mutually inconsistent phylogenetic positions for Laquintasaura, claiming it is either a basal ornithischian or a basal thyreophoran, and then stating it is sister to Scutellosaurus within Thyreophora.
Sentences 14 and 16 both state that Tachiraptor preyed upon Laquintasaura, repeating the same claim.
